mathematical_checks: Bansal–Sinha promise, normalization, error parameter, input length and fixed-k weakening to R(P)>L.
Exact arithmetic verifier and circuit-transcript role; adaptive pointer-query depth distinguished from fixed variable support.
Amplitude-amplification conditional-state contract, endpoint cases and every-branch cap.
Tournament drift identity, fresh-workspace product sampling, conditional index distribution and history-conditional coupling.
Off-promise winner guarantee and all-address verifier soundness.
Finite minimax applicability, fair-product supermartingale and nonheavy-and-hit event containment.
Planted input coupling, query charging, fixed-k exponent argument, and Appendix A inequality chain.
not_claimed: Complete independent reconstruction of the Bansal–Sinha Gaussian/interpolation proof or every cited proof.
An exhaustive novelty or priority search over the entire literature.
A completed independent human verification of the new preprint.
A Lean or Comparator run, a successful build, or a formal-to-informal equivalence audit.
A practical runtime or cryptographic consequence of the query separation.
Absence of unindexed, private or unpublished reviews.
